summary: Retire the empty pre-Task-009 inbox_events compatibility placeholder through a fail-closed contract migration while retaining inbox_receipts as the sole consumer idempotency store.

impacts.evidence: The tenantless deny-all placeholder is removed; the real inbox_receipts table remains organization/workspace scoped under forced RLS.
The retired table is required to be empty; no personal or business data is migrated or deleted.
No REST or OpenAPI surface changes.
Canonical event envelopes and the inbox_receipts deduplication identity remain unchanged.
No connector or plugin SDK surface changes.
High-risk contract migration 000064 removes only the qualified empty legacy relation after explicit fleet, traffic and backup gates.
Removing an unused tenantless relation reduces schema ambiguity; canonical receipts retain forced RLS and append-only guards.
No business action or approval policy changes.
Immutable inbox_receipts and migration_history evidence are retained.
Runtime already reads and writes only inbox_receipts; duplicate and collision behavior is unchanged.
No network destination or delivery behavior changes.
The zero-traffic qualification gate and post-migration relation-absence assertion make retirement observable.
An unexpected row or lock timeout rolls back atomically; post-commit recovery relies on the required verified backup or a forward repair.
Static migration tests cover phase, empty-table guard and drop; PostgreSQL tenancy rehearsal asserts fresh-install absence and canonical receipt isolation.
